operation: §187 — asymmetric structured owed-fact behavioural validation: PRE-SPEND STOP
terminalReason: The REQUIRED treatment is not executable on the component §179 measured: the first-pass Expert has no owed-fact input field. The only component that accepts an owed fact (the v3 verifier) needs a firstPass block that does not exist for any HR row, and its zero-owed-fact branch emits a false and strongly cueing sentence on SILENCE rows. Every executable variant materially changes what the validation measures, so the design choice was returned to the product owner before spend.

blockers.evidence: ExpertAnalysisInput (expert-contract.types.ts:542) has no owed-fact field; expert-input-constructor.ts and expert-contract.types.ts contain zero occurrences of 'owed'
blockers.consequence: the REQUIRED treatment as specified cannot be applied to the component §179 measured

blockers.consequence: running the v3 verifier on HR rows requires either extra provider calls or AUTHORING the stimulus — the confound that stopped §183
